g.text: Components of household net wealth in the US

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: Assets are shown above the line and debt below it, each as a multiple of US national income. The gap

g.text: Covers households and non-profit institutions serving households. “Financial assets and business capital” combines financial

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: assets with the fixed capital of personal businesses. Each series is divided by national income for the same year, so the ratio is
